item.title: SCP-5170: SCP-5170: +1
item.content:encoded: This is pretty long, but it works so well. I never got bored even once, and it was nice how a lot of stuff clicked perfectly, like pulling an already completed puzzle from a closet. It certainly was a bit confusing especially early on, but that's to be expected from a legal nightmare skip and it definitely clears up as it goes.

item.title: SCP-5415: Unfortunately, -1.
item.content:encoded:
This just seems to be an anomalous object itself, with no narrative to it. If you could create a central narrative centered around the object (obviously with a central theme), or something related to the object. If you were to do it skillfully, then you would have a good article.

Unfortunately, the article lacks a central plot and theme, and as such, I'm going to give it a -1.
